mapper.insert: insert into service_bookings (id, user_id, vehicle_id, service_type_id, scheduled_date, status, notes, created_at, updated_at) values( #{serviceBooking.id}, #{serviceBooking.userId}, #{serviceBooking.vehicleId}, #{serviceBooking.serviceTypeId}, #{serviceBooking.scheduledDate}, #{serviceBooking.status}, #{serviceBooking.notes}, #{serviceBooking.createdAt}, #{serviceBooking.updatedAt} )
